selection: candidates.csv camera==1 and model_id==selected_H; only source completed.json windows receipts; score source_metadata episode.kind==full600; partial tails excluded
aggregation: micro=sum sufficient_statistics.sum / sum sufficient_statistics.count for each metric; MAMPJPE count is valid source frames; episode_macro=unweighted average of each episode metric; recording_macro=unweighted average of within-recording micro
failure_policy: All full600 attempted windows retained. Failed rollouts contribute finite observed prefixes only; missing future frames are not zero-filled or penalty-imputed. Successful-only results are diagnostic secondary values.

metric_contract.FS: independent pressure contact AND human forward foot speed<0.15m/s; both adjacent endpoints
metric_contract.GlobalMorphMPJPE_target_root: shared18 target translated to released SMPL transl before fixed initial SE2
metric_contract.PhysicalContactSlip_cm_s: actual virtual forefoot marker during force contact; not the moving geometric contact point
metric_contract.Viol: official per-foot median predicted contact ground; actual plane metrics separately named
metric_contract.pressure_events: all target events inside common source support retained; unmatched unexecuted events count FN
